label: Series and parallel reduction
subgoals: Add resistances that carry the same current
Add conductances of resistors that share the same voltage
Reduce the network from the innermost group outward

label: Voltage and current dividers
subgoals: Write the divider ratio as the bottom resistance over the total
Send the larger current share through the smaller parallel resistor
Multiply the ratio by the source voltage or current

label: Loading a divider
subgoals: Combine the load in parallel with the bottom resistor
Recompute the divider ratio with the combined bottom resistance
Compare the loaded output with the unloaded value
